name: Kho qua rung
summary: Khổ qua rừng, wild bitter melon, is one of the forest specialties sold at the Mang Den weekend market.
where: Chợ phiên Măng Đen, the weekend market, meets on Saturday and Sunday on the pine hill along Hùng Vương. Báo Kon Tum also places it in the pine garden (Vườn thông) by the district central square.
seoTitle: Kho qua rung in Mang Den
seoDescription: Khổ qua rừng, wild bitter melon, at the Mang Den weekend market.
